title: Walmart Shares Extend Decline After Rare US Sales Miss
title_cn: 沃尔玛股价在罕见的美国销售失误后继续下跌
summary:
Walmart Inc.’s quarterly sales fell short of expectations, a rare miss that’s likely to stoke concern about the leading big-box retailer decelerating alongside a slow-growing US economy.

Sales at US stores open at least a year, excluding fuel, rose 2.6% in the second quarter, shy of the lowest analyst estimate compiled by Bloomberg. That rate of growth — hindered primarily by pricing pressure in its pharmacy business — is the slowest in more than six years.

Walmart shares fell as much as 10%, the most intraday since 2022, in New York trading on Thursday, erasing a modest year-to-date gain through the previous day’s close. We get reaction from Poonam Goyal, Senior US Retail Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: What the AI Industry Got Wrong About Public Backlash
title_cn: 人工智能行业在公众强烈反对方面犯了什么错误
summary:
Even those within the AI industry have been very anxious about the technology. Worries about its potential to create destabilizing job losses, or rogue AI that could lead to human extinction. But for all their anxiety, they missed the thing that's become the most publicly salient: how upset people would be about data centers. Data center construction has been happening for a long time, and it used to be relatively uncontroversial. In fact, cities and states would often design their tax code to incentivize data center construction. On this episode, we speak with independent writer and Substacker Jasmine Sun, who recently traveled to Wisconsin and Michigan to report about the communities and activists trying to stop development, what the pushback is really all about and what future developers will have to do in order to be welcomed in.

title: Iran’s President Says Better to End War Today
title_cn: 伊朗总统表示最好今天结束战争
summary:
Iran’s president urged an end to the war with the US, in his latest pushback against hardliners who want to continue the conflict.

“It would be better to end the war today, when we have power and dignity, and with the whole world acknowledging our victory,” Masoud Pezeshkian said, according to the semi-official Iranian Students’ News Agency.
 
Pezeshkian, along with Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and lead negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, have been vocal advocates of ending the war through diplomacy and prioritizing economic recovery since the signing of a now-collapsed ceasefire. His comments come as the conflict shows no sign of a quick resolution and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to unveil plans to economically isolate Iran and its trading partners. We get the latest from Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Military Emerges as Key Market for Centrus Enriched Uranium
title_cn: 美国军方成为 Centrus 浓缩铀的主要市场
summary: Centrus Energy Corp. sees a new market for its enriched uranium coming from the US military, as the nuclear fuel producer awaits a potential boost from a supply deal to meet America’s security needs.
